description.en: Two axial fans drive a conceptual airflow path across the cooler. The exact-SKU review reports six heatpipes (four central and two lateral) and an air-through PCB cutout. The animated outlet path illustrates this design intent; it is not CFD or a measured velocity field.
description.ru: Два осевых вентилятора создают условный поток через кулер. В обзоре точного SKU указаны шесть тепловых трубок (четыре центральные и две боковые) и сквозной вырез в PCB. Анимированный выходной поток иллюстрирует эту конструкцию, но не является CFD или измеренным полем скоростей.

assumptions: No CFD or thermal model is present.
Exact fan curves, fin pitch, heatpipe routing and thermal resistance are unknown.
No CFD, pressure field, fan curve or measured airflow vector is available.
Airflow particles are directional educational markers, not fluid parcels or velocity vectors.
Heatpipe count, routing, diameter and thermal resistance are not verified.
The six-pipe count and air-through PCB feature are sourced from an exact-SKU review; individual pipe routes and the cutout contour remain photo-estimated.

description.en: A single auxiliary 8-pin input is shown feeding a schematic power-conversion zone and GPU package. Moving pulses are educational direction cues; they are not routed PCB copper, pin mapping or an electrical simulation.
description.ru: Показан один дополнительный вход 8-pin, условно связанный с зоной преобразования питания и корпусом GPU. Движущиеся импульсы обозначают направление, а не реальные дорожки PCB, распиновку или электрическую симуляцию.

assumptions: No circuit simulation or exact-board schematic is available.
Do not infer pin-level wiring from the connector shape.
No exact-board schematic, BoardView, verified PCB revision, pin mapping or current values are available.
The connector-to-GPU pulse path is an educational schematic, not routed PCB copper or an electrical simulation.
